name: ag-visualizer
description: A calm, passive, privacy-first live visual map of Antigravity IDE agent activity.

commands.title: Antigravity Work Map: Open Beside Chat
Antigravity Work Map: Toggle Demo Mode

agVisualizer.language.description: Language for station labels and activity feed rows.

agVisualizer.theme.description: Map color theme. 'auto' follows the active IDE color theme.

agVisualizer.background.description: Paint the map's own background or leave the IDE pane surface showing through.

agVisualizer.layout.description: Place 'You' at the top or bottom of the station ring.

agVisualizer.motion.description: Animation style. 'reduced' replaces flying pulses and spins with gentle fades.

agVisualizer.coreName.description: Short label shown inside the central core node (up to 12 characters).

agVisualizer.contextCost.description: Estimate how many tokens each step added to the context window.

agVisualizer.contextWindowTokens.description: Override context window denominator in tokens (0 uses model-aware defaults, e.g. 1,000,000 for Gemini).

agVisualizer.textSize.description: Font size scale for the activity feed under the map.

agVisualizer.subagentNames.description: Show short subagent role labels on subagent steps.

agVisualizer.colors.description: Override palette colors by role name (background, node, line, spoke, text, label, faint, accent, active, error, memory, memoryActive, route).

agVisualizer.memoryPaths.description: Additional path fragments classified under the Memory station.

agVisualizer.memoryServers.description: MCP server names classified under the Memory station.

agVisualizer.memoryCommands.description: Shell command names classified under the Memory station.

agVisualizer.serverStations.description: Map MCP server names to specific station IDs.

agVisualizer.commandStations.description: Map shell command names to specific station IDs.

agVisualizer.antigravityDataDir.description: Optional override path for Antigravity data directory (defaults to ~/.gemini/antigravity). Application-scoped for security.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:surface && npm test && npm run build
